title: tool_paramhlp: reject trailing garbage in seconds arguments
body:
secs2ms(), used for --connect-timeout, --expect100-timeout, --max-time, --retry-delay and --retry-max-time, did not check that the whole argument was consumed. Values like "10m" or "1.5abc" were silently accepted as 10 and 1.5 seconds, while str2num() and friends reject such input.

Also return PARAM_BAD_NUMERIC instead of PARAM_NUMBER_TOO_LARGE when no digits follow the decimal point, as in "1.".

Unit test tool1623 verifies.

files.patch:
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@ tool-sizeparser
 unittest
 </features>
 <name>
-the size parser for --limit-rate
+the size parser for --limit-rate and the seconds parser for timeouts
 </name>
 </client>
